Maya (growth): Hey @Jordan — for the webinar next Tue can you run a focused variance decomposition on the latency numbers we used in the deck? Need breakdown by p50/p95/p99, batch size 1/4/8, and quantized vs fp16. Also want prefix-cache on/off.

Jordan (runtime): Sure. Do you want the same seed/sample set as last run or a fresh draw? Also which model variant? rdx-llama-7b-qat or rdx-7b-fp16?

Maya (growth): Use fresh draw (~1k queries) stratified by prompt length (<128, 128-512, >512). Narrative we want: explain tail latency drivers and show how prefix caching helps p95. Also call out observed tokenization overhead if any. Deadline EOD Fri.

Alex K: @Jordan quick ask — can you include per-token ms and a small table with network vs compute vs scheduling breakdown? PMs will want that.

Jordan (runtime): Got it. Will run three axes: batch sizes [1,4,8], caching [on,off], model variants [fp16,8-bit]. Expect ~6 runs x 1k queries. Est run time ~3hrs on a dedicated node. I'll push artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/latency-var/1998765432/ and post a smoke csv. :thumbsup:

Sam R: Please add a column for prompt bucket and tokenized token_count. Last time we missed token_count and it hid a lot of variance.

Jordan (runtime): Good call. I'll include token_count and a small reproducible command: ```python bench_runner.py --model rdx-llama-7b --variant fp16 --batch 4 --cache on --seed 42 --input samples/stratified_1k.json --out out/1998765432.csv```

Maya (growth): @runtime-bot can you run an automated sanity check on the output: ensure p50/p95/p99 within ±15% of our original numbers or flag for follow-up? We need a quick pass before slides.

runtime-bot: Auto-check scheduled. Will compare against baseline s3://redwood-marketing/baselines/latency_summary.json and emit a report.

Jordan (runtime): One more note — quantized 8-bit sometimes shows lower per-token compute but higher scheduling variance under batch 1. If capacity is tight I might suggest running a 10k sample later for stable tail estimates.

Maya (growth): Fine to start with 1k for slide prep, but add a small note about limited sample size and we'll call out that we plan a larger sweep post-launch.

Alex K: Thx. Please ping this thread with final s3 links and a short 2-bullet summary we can paste into the PRD.
